words.gloss: to become known at the end
if it becomes known in the middle

literal: To become known at the end, doing what is fit, is capability; if it becomes known in the middle, unremovable sorrow it will give.
translation: True capability is executing a fitting task so that it becomes known only upon its completion. If it is revealed midway, it will cause inescapable sorrow.
modern: ஒரு செயலை அதன் முடிவில் வெளிப்படும்படியாகச் செய்து முடிப்பதே திறமையாகும். இடையில் அச்செயல் வெளிப்பட்டால் அது நீங்காத துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of secrecy and timing in executing a plan. The word 'ஆண்மை' (manliness or capability) here refers to the strength of character required to keep a plan concealed until it is successfully completed. The verb 'கொட்க' means to become known or revealed. If a fitting action is exposed in the middle ('இடைக்கொட்கின்') before completion, obstacles can easily thwart it. Such a premature revelation will result in 'எற்றா விழுமம்', meaning an inescapable or unremovable sorrow.
